units.invariant: FileStorage.peek_data() must acquire self.lock to honor FileStorage's exclusive-lock guarantee and prevent TOCTOU open failures when pop_data() unlinks keys.
reproducer_checks: Executed 50x 4-thread barrier trials (peek_data vs put_data/pop_data, 110 ops/thread) in reproducers/huey_chaos_benchmark.py.

units.invariant: FileStorage.enqueued_items() must acquire self.lock so queue inspection never tries to open task files simultaneously unlinked by dequeue().
reproducer_checks: Executed 50x 4-thread barrier trials (enqueued_items vs enqueue/dequeue, 45 ops/thread) in reproducers/huey_chaos_benchmark.py.

units.invariant: FileStorage.result_items() must acquire self.lock when walking result_path and reading files to prevent PermissionError/FileNotFoundError races.
reproducer_checks: Executed 50x 4-thread barrier trials (result_items vs put_data/pop_data, 35 ops/thread) in reproducers/huey_chaos_benchmark.py.

units.invariant: Newly written temp result files must have data blocks flushed via os.fsync before os.replace so a power loss never produces an empty replacement file.
reproducer_checks: Inspected FileStorage._put_data at huey/storage.py:1552-1558; calls os.replace(tmp, filename) without fh.flush() or os.fsync(fh.fileno()).
unresolved: Reproducing post-rename zero-byte data loss on delayed allocation filesystems requires block-device power-cut / dm-flakey injection.

units.invariant: Concurrent worker threads calling SqliteStorage.dequeue() must deliver every queued task at most once without duplicates or lost tasks.
reproducer_checks: Disprover verified BaseSqlStorage.db self.lock + begin exclusive at huey/storage.py:821-852,936-950 and ran 50x 4-thread drain trials (0 duplicates, 0 errors).

units.invariant: Concurrent MemoryStorage.result_items() vs. put_data()/pop_data() must not raise RuntimeError: dictionary changed size during iteration under standard CPython.
reproducer_checks: Disprover ran 50x 4-thread barrier trials (result_items vs put_data/pop_data): 0/50 RuntimeErrors because CPython PyDict_Copy executes atomically under the GIL.
